newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hoya shares up on group earnings gain.
newsitem.headline: Hoya shares up on group earnings gain.

text.p: Hoya Corp's shares were higher in Tuesday afternoon trade, inspired by a rise in the optical glass firm's group earnings for the interim period, brokers said.
As of 0508 GMT, the shares were up 70 yen at 3,990 yen.
"Overall trade is lacking in direction but shares of companies showing solid performances are being sought after by investors," a trader at a medium-sized brokerage said.
Hoya's group current profits for the six months to September 30, 1996, were 17.03 billion yen, up from 13.40 billion yen in the same period a year ago.
